description: Traefik ingress metrics dashboard (router-label version). Uses traefik_router_* for request, status, traffic and latency panels. The ingress and namespace filters come from ServiceMonitor metricRelabelings derived from the Traefik router label.

panels.description: Request count per $__interval window, broken down by namespace. Each point is the increase over one scrape window, not a period cumulative total.
panels.title: HTTP Requests / Namespace

panels.description: Cumulative total of HTTP requests over the entire selected dashboard time range. Not comparable to interval-based panels.

targets.expr: sum(increase(traefik_router_requests_total{ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[${__range_s}s]))

panels.title: Requests (period)

panels.description: HTTP requests in the most recent Prometheus scrape window ($__interval). Shows the latest bucket value, not the full period total.

targets.expr: sum(increase(traefik_router_requests_total{ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Reqs ($__interval)

panels.description: Successful requests (1xx and 2xx) in the last interval.

targets.expr: sum(increase(traefik_router_requests_total{code=~"[12]..", ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[$__interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: HTTP 1/2xx ($__interval)

panels.description: Percentage of successful requests handled by selected routers in the last interval. 404 responses are excluded.

targets.expr:
sum(rate(traefik_router_requests_total{code!~"4..|5..", ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[$__interval]))
/ (
  sum(rate(traefik_router_requests_total{ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[$__interval]))
  - (sum(rate(traefik_router_requests_total{code="404", ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[$__interval])) or vector(0))
)

panels.title: % Success ($__interval)

panels.description: Open connections at selected Traefik entrypoints. This metric is global by entrypoint and has no router label.

targets.expr: sum(avg_over_time(traefik_open_connections{entrypoint=~"$entrypoint"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Conns ($__interval)

panels.description: Percentage of successful requests over the entire selected dashboard time range. 404 responses are excluded from the denominator.

targets.expr:
sum(rate(traefik_router_requests_total{code!~"4..|5..", ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[${__range_s}s]))
/ (
  sum(rate(traefik_router_requests_total{ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[${__range_s}s]))
  - (sum(rate(traefik_router_requests_total{code="404", ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[${__range_s}s])) or vector(0))
)

panels.title: % Success (period)

panels.description: Redirect responses (3xx) in the last interval.

targets.expr: sum(increase(traefik_router_requests_total{code=~"3..", ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[$__interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: HTTP 3xx ($__interval)

panels.description: Client error responses (4xx) in the last interval.

targets.expr: sum(increase(traefik_router_requests_total{code=~"4..", ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[$__interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: HTTP 4xx ($__interval)

panels.description: Server error responses (5xx) in the last interval.

targets.expr: sum(increase(traefik_router_requests_total{code=~"5..", ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[$__interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: HTTP 5xx ($__interval)

panels.description: Request count per $__interval window, broken down by ingress. Each point is the increase over one scrape window, not a period cumulative total.

targets.expr: sum(increase(traefik_router_requests_total{ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[$__interval])) by (ingress)

panels.title: HTTP Requests / Ingress

panels.description: Breakdown of HTTP status codes for selected Traefik routers.

targets.expr: sum(increase(traefik_router_requests_total{ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[$__interval])) by (code)

panels.title: HTTP Status Codes

panels.description: Request count per $__interval window, broken down by rule path. Each point is the increase over one scrape window, not a period cumulative total.
panels.title: HTTP Requests / Rule Path

panels.description: Aggregate request count per $__interval window over time. Each bar is the increase over one scrape window; compare with Requests (period) for the full-range cumulative total.

targets.expr: sum(increase(traefik_router_requests_total{ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: HTTP Requests over time ($__interval)

panels.description: Request latency percentiles for selected Traefik routers. Average uses sum/count instead of bucket midpoints.

targets.expr:
sum(rate(traefik_router_request_duration_seconds_sum{code!="404", code!="500", code!="304", ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[$__interval]))
/ sum(rate(traefik_router_request_duration_seconds_count{code!="404", code!="500", code!="304", ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Latency (Average Percentiles)

panels.description: Request latency percentiles for selected Traefik routers. Average uses sum/count instead of bucket midpoints.

targets.expr:
(
  sum by (ingress) (
    rate(
      traefik_router_request_duration_seconds_sum{
        code!="404",
        code!="500",
        code!="304",
        ingress_namespace=~"$namespace",
        ingress_namespace!="",
        ingress=~"$ingress",
        ingress!="",
        router=~"$router",
        exported_service=~"$service"
      }[$__interval]
    )
  )
  /
  sum by (ingress) (
    rate(
      traefik_router_request_duration_seconds_count{
        code!="404",
        code!="500",
        code!="304",
        ingress_namespace=~"$namespace",
        ingress_namespace!="",
        ingress=~"$ingress",
        ingress!="",
        router=~"$router",
        exported_service=~"$service"
      }[$__interval]
    )
  )
)
and on (ingress)
(
  sum by (ingress) (
    rate(traefik_router_request_duration_seconds_count{code!="404", code!="500", code!="304", ingress_namespace=~"$namespace", ingress_namespace!="", ingress=~"$ingress", ingress!="", router=~"$router", exported_service=~"$service"}[$__interval])
  ) > 0
)

panels.title: Latency / Ingress

panels.description: Request latency percentiles for selected Traefik routers. Average uses sum/count instead of bucket midpoints.
